fonts.display: 'TT Ramillas Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Page canvas and primary card surfaces — the warm beige that carries the entire interface

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Secondary surface tone for elevated sections and subtle layering above parchment

palette.name: Warm Stone
palette.role: Hairline borders and 1px section dividers throughout the interface

palette.name: Walnut
palette.role: Muted helper text, captions, and de-emphasized metadata

palette.name: Espresso
palette.role: Secondary body text and subhead copy — warm dark gray that softens pure black

palette.name: Onyx Warm
palette.role: Primary text, navigation, headings, and dark surface fills

palette.name: Midnight Roast
palette.role: Deepest dark surface for photo overlays and high-contrast hero backgrounds

palette.name: Saffron Glow
palette.role: Sole chromatic accent — featured tags, active states, decorative punctuation; warm spice-orange against the beige canvas creates curated restraint
